Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technical Assistant post at Central Rice Research Institute is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture, Biological Sciences, Botany, or Bioinformatics to be eligible for the Technical Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Technical Assistant position is between 21 years and 55 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technical Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post at Central Rice Research Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant post will involve a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha. Specific venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contractual basis.
